data.notes: The search budget (20 WebSearch calls) was used up. The official SEAT technical sheet PDFs (mundoseat.seat.com) could not be read in full; the values come mainly from ADAC Autokatalog entries (manufacturer data), SEAT's own KL-vs-predecessor comparisons, and third-party databases where noted. Leon 1M (1999-2005) is included because it was still sold in 2005; drop it if only generations launched in 2005 or later are wanted. Ibiza SC/ST and Leon SC are separate body styles and are not returned.

corrections.evidence: Parkers (1.2 TSI SE 5d), auto-data.net (Leon III 2012-2016) and automobile-catalog list 4263 mm long, 1816 mm wide, 1459 mm high, wheelbase 2636 mm for the standard 5-door. 1444 mm is the lowered FR figure (SEAT Leon 5D tech sheet: FR 4281/1816/1444).
SEAT technical sheet 'New SEAT Leon 5D' (2016/17 facelift): Reference/Style/Xcellence 4282/1816/1459 mm; FR 4281/1816/1444 mm. Auto Express also gives 4282 mm long, 1459 mm tall.
SEAT 'New SEAT Leon 5D' sheet: 1459 mm height for Reference/Style/Xcellence; 1444 mm only for the FR (sport suspension). automobiledimension.com and Auto Express also give 1459 mm.

angurten.de Leon ST 2014 (5F): length 4535 mm, width 1816 mm without mirrors, height 1451 mm, wheelbase 2636 mm. sizedly.com also gives 1451 mm for the 2013 ST. These are third-party figures; the manufacturer's value was not found.

ADAC Autokatalog, Leon ST 1.4 TGI Start&Stop Style (09/14-11/16): trunk 482 l normal, 1365 l roof-high with seats folded. This matches the auto.de test (482-1365 l). The 1470 l value from autokosten is the non-CNG figure.

Leon 1P Cupra (240 PS, 2007-2009) variant not listed.
Ibiza 6L Cupra / FR and 6J Cupra / FR variants not listed (6J FR/Cupra lengths differ: about 4061-4072 mm per auto-swiat.pl).

verification.notes: Confirmed values: Ibiza 6L 3953/1698/1441/2460, 267/960 l (cars-data.com, ADAC 5-door entries also give 267 l). Ibiza 6J 4052/1693/1445/2469, 292/938 l (SEAT April 2008 announcement via autozine.nl, cars-data.com). Ibiza 6J FL 4061 mm (auto-data 1.2 12V 2012), 292 l. Leon 1M 4184/1742/1439, wheelbase 2511-2513, 340 l (auto-data.net). Leon 1P 4315/1768/2578, 341/1166 l. Leon 5F 4263/1816/2636, 380/1210 l. Leon ST 5F 4535 mm, 587/1470 l, wheelbase 2636 (angurten), 1.4 TGI 482 l (ADAC). Leon ST FL 4549/1454/2636 (ultimatespecs 1.0 EcoTSI), 587/1470. Leon ST FL 1.5 TGI: ADAC lists 587/1470 l for the 1.5 TGI entries (12/18-01/20), but this conflicts with the R+V test (487 l) and the expected CNG-tank loss, so it stays null with no correction. The pre-facelift Leon ST wheelbase is 2634 mm in one review, versus 2636 mm per angurten; it was not changed. The Leon 1M minimum trunk is 270 l per autoscout24 vs 340 l per auto-data; 340 l was kept.
